quote: We evaluate MEDA on diverse mutlimodal long-context datasets including MileBench, Video-ChatGPT, DREAM-1K, and WorldQA.

We evaluate MEDA across various recent MLLM backbones, including LLaVA-v1.5-13B, LLaVA-NeXT-7B, and InternVL-v1.5-7B for multi-images tasks, as well as LLaVA-Video-7B/32B, LongVA-7B, and LongVILA-8B for long-video tasks. We also evaluate on diverse multimodal long-context datasets including MileBench, Video-ChatGPT, DREAM-1K, and WorldQA.
